one_line: Most of this work is renting and servicing ordinary portable toilets across Dallas with 2-hour emergency response, which takes a local portable-toilet fleet and pump trucks our profile doesn't list, the NAICS/PSC isn't one of ours, and bids are due in 6 days with no solicitation documents in hand.
scope: The City of Dallas wants a 3-year ID/IQ service price agreement, with two 1-year renewal options, to rent and maintain portable toilets for the public and City staff at sites across the city, ordered as needed (estimated $450,000–$1,800,000). Unit types are regular portable toilets, ADA-compliant units, handicapped accessible units, comfort station trailers, and special event rentals. The contractor delivers within 48 hours, removes within 24 hours, meets emergency requests within 2 hours, cleans seven days a week, and handles graffiti abatement and minor repairs within 72 hours.
fit: Comfort station trailers and ADA units match our restroom trailer fleet (restroom/shower trailers with sealed gray/black tanks; ADA units on request).
Portable sanitation is one of our stated core competencies (Facility Support & Utilities).

Relevant SLED past performance: City and County of Denver, SC-00011558, Aug 2026 – ongoing. Climate-controlled portable restroom trailers with cleaning, pump-outs, waste disposal, supplies, and maintenance for up to 500 people.
Other restroom-trailer past performance: USCG Station Lake Worth Inlet, 70Z02826FMIAM0008 ($78,500, 2026) and U.S. Navy Oregon under Vigor Marine Group ($127,240, 2018–2019).

Our SBE status could count toward the DRIVE 5.71% SBE participation goal, if the City recognizes our certification. Another option: offer comfort station trailers as an SBE subcontractor to a local portable-toilet prime instead of bidding as prime.
red_flags: The core requirement is regular portable toilets. Our fleet and price list have no standard portable toilet units, only restroom/shower trailers.

The 2-hour emergency response and 7-day-a-week cleaning (7:30 a.m.–3:30 p.m.) need a local fleet, trucks, and crew. Our profile states 24–72 hour deployment, weekly servicing, and 24-hour on-site response for critical failures, from a Marina del Rey, CA base, and lists no Texas depot.
The deadline (2026-11-20) is 6 days away, and the bid pack has 0 attachments. We haven't seen the actual bid form, specifications, pricing schedule, insurance, bonding, or license requirements.

The bid requires at least three years of verifiable experience providing similar services, plus portable toilet rental and maintenance references. Our Denver restroom trailer work started in Aug 2026.
This is a long multi-year commodity service contract, and local pumping and portable-toilet firms compete hard on price (one benchmark drew 31 offers).
HigherGov lists the set-aside as 'SBA', which is unclear for a city bid. The only small-business requirement the pack states is the DRIVE SBE participation goal.
competition: The bid pack shows no City of Dallas awards under NAICS 562991, so the incumbent is unknown. The 25 benchmarks are mostly federal vault-pumping and portable-toilet awards won by local sanitation firms, such as BIG Valley Sanitation, D&M Pumping, 4K Sanitation, and Access Portable Toilets. Offers ranged from 1 to 31: Access Portable Toilets, North Charleston, SC drew 31; D&M Pumping, Sausalito, CA drew 2. Expect Dallas-area portable-toilet companies with their own fleets and pump trucks.
price_signal: There's no Dallas or SLED price history. The closest benchmarks are D&M Pumping, portable and vault toilet services, Sausalito, CA, $277,330 over about 5 years (2 offers); BIG Valley Sanitation, portable toilets and hand wash stations with weekly service, Redding, CA, $65,762 over 5 years (2 offers); 4K Sanitation, portable toilet rental for RIMPAC, $93,740 over about 7 weeks; and Access Portable Toilets, $9,251 for a 1-year contract (31 offers). The City's estimate is $450,000–$1,800,000 over up to 5 years. Our price list has no standard portable toilet row. The closest rows are Luxury Shower-Restroom Combination Trailers (13ft, 3 stalls: $2,995–$3,995; 22ft, 6 stalls: $4,995–$5,995), but the list doesn't say whether those rates are daily, weekly, monthly, or per term, and both ADA rows are blank.
